avoid_supplements.name: Probiotics (high-dose, during therapy)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Meropenem is a broad-spectrum antibiotic that kills beneficial gut bacteria; high-dose probiotics during therapy may compete with endogenous flora recovery
avoid_supplements.action: Initiate probiotics at least 2 hours apart from meropenem dosing; consider waiting until post-treatment or use low-dose formulations

avoid_supplements.name: Valproic Acid / Valproate Supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Meropenem reduces serum valproic acid levels by 30-60% through unknown mechanism, potentially causing loss of seizure control
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; monitor serum valproate levels closely if coadministration is unavoidable

caution_supplements.name: Calcium and Magnesium Supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May reduce meropenem absorption if taken simultaneously; meropenem is typically IV-administered, minimizing interaction risk
caution_supplements.action: Space oral supplements 2 hours apart from any oral meropenem formulation if available

caution_foods.name: High-fiber foods (during treatment)
caution_foods.mechanism: Excessive fiber may alter gut motility and bacterial flora composition, potentially affecting antibiotic efficacy or GI tolerance
caution_foods.action: Maintain normal fiber intake; avoid sudden increases during meropenem therapy

monitoring_notes: Meropenem is primarily renally excreted with minimal hepatic metabolism, reducing CYP450 interaction risk. Monitor renal function, seizure control if patient on anticonvulsants (especially valproate), and assess for Clostridioides difficile infection risk given broad-spectrum coverage.
